name: rubin
provenance: GMMU VER3 incl. PCF: NVIDIA published hopper/gh100 dev_mmu.h; 6-level split 1/9/9/9/8/9(+12) per RM/nouveau gh100 descriptors; Blackwell adds 256 GiB pages at PD2 (NVIDIA_HW_FACTS.md 4.2-4.4).
Chipset ids (NV_PMC_BOOT_0[28:20]), NVML architecture ids and CUDA compute capabilities: docs/research/NVIDIA_HW_FACTS.md section 5 (ids marked 'derived' are not listed by any source).
Engine classes per chip: docs/research/NVIDIA_COMMAND_FACTS.md section 0 (nouveau/GSP-RM/nvgpu tables).
QMD version is read from each descriptor (all published layouts V00_06..V05_00 are decoded).
Rubin: chip ids derived and classes assumed equal to Blackwell - forward-compatibility only.
